teams.synopsis: Dominant through two weeks, averaging 136 a game — and doing it all without even an RB2 on the roster.
teams.blurb: Picking up right where they left off last season, Grits has been dominant through the first two weeks, averaging 136 points per game. The team is doing all this without even having an RB2 on the roster, though a trade may be on the horizon. It also helps when your kicker is averaging 17 points a week. This is a scary team. Projected record: 10-4.

teams.synopsis: A transformed franchise since 2023, averaging 121 a week over thirty matchups — the best Week 2 in the league.
teams.blurb: This franchise has been transformed since 2023, averaging 121 points per week over thirty matchups in that span. STD posted the best Week 2 in the league thanks to the TE1, RB2, and QB4. Now imagine if A.J. Brown wasn't averaging just 4.8 points. This team could be special. Projected record: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: Last place in 2024, one of the top teams in 2025 — an argument could even be made for ranking them higher.
teams.blurb: It's great for the league that the last-place team from 2024 is now one of the top teams in 2025. There's even a case for them to be ranked higher, but for now, top three is not too bad. Ladd has underperformed so far, but he should rebound, while TE can be improved. Tough Week 3 matchup ahead. Projected record: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: A trade for Henderson could bring much-needed RB production — Mason fills in until then.
teams.blurb: Not too shabby. I traded for Henderson, hoping he can bring some much-needed RB production in the coming weeks, but Mason might fill in as RB1 until then, with Jones potentially out for Week 3. A tough matchup awaits against another top team in the league. Projected record: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: A really solid team led by the QB1, RB4, and RB9 — could break into the top three if the WRs start producing.
teams.blurb: A really solid team led by the QB1, RB4, and RB9. This group could break into the top three if the TE, WRs, and Hampton start producing. MFGA faces a sneaky tough test in Week 3, so that boost might be needed sooner rather than later. Perhaps Addison can supply some WR production soon. Projected record: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: Average through two weeks, but more balance across the lineup gives this team a higher upside.
teams.blurb: Another team that's been pretty average through two weeks, but there's more balance across the starting lineup, which gives higher upside. Nabers and Warren have been great, while Brown and Moore have been disappointing. The Week 3 matchup against a top-five team should be competitive. Projected record: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: Probably close to the team's floor already — only one direction to go from here.
teams.blurb: We just saw what happens when the Jets stack struggles and the rest of the lineup (aside from JT) puts up a dud. The way I see it, this was probably close to the team's floor, and there's only one direction to go from here. I like LP to rebound in Week 3 against a new RWB squad. Projected record: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: A 0-2 team ranked ahead of teams with a win — strong but unlucky, with the WRs and TE still underwhelming.
teams.blurb: This is one of those rankings where people might question why a 0-2 team is ahead of multiple teams with a win. BLR was strong in Week 2 but just unlucky, and I don't expect that to last. The WRs and TE have been underwhelming. With a tough matchup in Week 3, they must not fall to 0-3. Projected record: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: The most average team through two weeks — great RBs, but QB/WR/TE have all disappointed so far.
teams.blurb: Probably the most average team through two weeks, sitting at 1-1 and right in the middle of the league for points scored. The RBs are incredible, and both the D/ST and kicker are contributing, but the QB, WR, and TE positions have been disappointing. Maye and Fannin may change that. Projected record: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: Responded to a rough Week 1 with a 142-point Week 2 — Ja'Marr looked incredible, RBs combined for 45.
teams.blurb: After scoring just 75 points in Week 1, NY needed to respond, and they did with a 142-point performance in Week 2. Ja'Marr looked incredible, while the RBs combined for 45 points. It looks like a key factor in New York's success will be starting the right players at WR2 and flex each week. Projected record: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: Starting 0-2 is a strange sight for this franchise — a recent trade added a starting-caliber TE.
teams.blurb: The Minutemen starting 0-2 is a strange sight. Maybe the team is finally having a down year after being great for the past 4 seasons. A recent trade revamped the roster and gave the team a starting-caliber TE. The Minutemen are projected to win big in Week 3, but only time will tell. Projected record: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: A better Week 2 (116 points) despite falling to 0-2 — the RBs have been solid, the WRs still lack consistency.
teams.blurb: Week 1 was rough, but Week 2 was more promising with a 116-point performance. Despite falling to 0-2, this team rises in the rankings and looks poised for a big Week 3. The RBs have been solid (aside from Jeanty), but the team still lacks top-tier consistency from its WRs. Projected record: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: Very active in the trade market, which makes this ranking tough to pin — losing Burrow is brutal, but a bounce back feels real.
teams.blurb: RWB has been very active in the trade market recently, which makes the Week 3 ranking tough to pin down. Losing Burrow is brutal, but there's a real chance this team bounces back and gets its first win and perhaps more than 100 points soon. Until then, this spot feels fair. Projected record: 4-10.

teams.synopsis: Talent to be good, but the players haven't produced yet — the Judkins trade could supply real upside.
teams.blurb: It doesn't feel right to put this team at 14, because it has the talent to be good, but the players have underperformed so far. The RB2 slot has been shaky, but perhaps the Judkins trade supplies some upside to the lineup. Don't be surprised if the team climbs the rankings soon. Projected record: 4-10.
